scope: Run only the frozen serialize-javascript vulnerable pre-fix protected holdout to a terminal zero-deferred state.

protected_subject.digest_encoding: Tree digest is SHA-256 of a compact UTF-8 JSON array ordered by relative path; each row contains path, file SHA-256, and byte size.

historical_observation.qualification: Descriptive planning evidence only; it is not reused as the same-store calibration observation.

data_transfer.content: Bounded repository-derived evidence from the frozen protected pre-fix snapshot

execution_policy.first_batch: Start one fresh foreground pipeline from the exact frozen source path.
execution_policy.continuation: If deferred findings remain, use only linked production resume batches for the ingested repository identity.
execution_policy.terminal_requirement: Stop successfully only at zero deferred findings; retain every batch and all authoritative usage.
execution_policy.isolation: Do not inspect, execute, disclose, or bill the post-fix protected snapshot under this receipt.
execution_policy.no_tuning: Do not change prompts, models, selection, thresholds, priors, or operational limits based on protected output.

stop_conditions: The pinned commit, source path, tree digest, manifest digest, or protected-role metadata changes.
Any provider attempt lacks authoritative usage metadata.
Any batch fails or encounters a transport timeout.
Any call, token, dollar, or three-batch aggregate ceiling is reached or would be exceeded.
The pre-fix pending queue reaches zero.
excluded: The protected post-fix snapshot, any prompt or parameter tuning, and the offline three-run comparison are not authorized.
next_gate: Merge this receipt, then obtain explicit authorization for its exact protected pre-fix evidence transfer and ceilings before reading the keychain or making provider calls.
